0x10053A00.name: MeshRes_StopGenerators
0x10053A00.evidence: walks the mesh resource manager (ResourceIter_FindNext over type 5) for resources with bit 2 of +0x1A whose owner at +0xF4 matches, and calls YmGenerater_Stop, CMoResource_ReleaseChain and MoRes_FreeIfUnreferenced on each
0x10053A00.summary: Stops the generators of the mesh resources owned by an object and releases them.

0x10053C80.name: YmGenerater_UpdateAttach
0x10053C80.evidence: calls YmGenerater_BuildAttachMatrix on this+0x30 and stores the result at +0x90; then blends four floats and three rows of four floats toward the attach matrix by the weight (param_1 + 4) >> 2 and 1/255 steps, depending on the bits of param_1 + 4
0x10053C80.summary: Rebuilds the generator's attach matrix and blends the attached transform toward it by the weight.
